turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome in. My name is Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I came in because my eating has just gotten all turned around lately. It's been going on for months now. Some days I just pick at a piece of toast and have some coffee, and that's all I can manage. But then other days, I'll find myself just standing in the bakery aisle buying all these sweets that I don't even really enjoy. It's just very off.
